name: J & J's Mexican Food
notes: Six photos of digital TV menu boards. Several boards were photographed more than once at different times with different (rising) prices: the Burritos/Combinations/Rolled Tacos/Mini Tacos/Appetizers board appears in photos 1, 2 and 4 with three different price sets, and the Breakfast/Quesadillas/Appetizers/Kids/Tortas/Enchiladas board appears in photos 3 and 5 (photo 5 is a blacklight-filtered re-shoot) with two different price sets. Prices below use photo 1 and photo 3 (the clearest, non-distorted shots); the newer/older duplicate prices seen in photos 2, 4 and 5 were not used, so figures may be stale relative to current pricing — hence medium confidence. Rolled Tacos and Mini Tacos also reappear in photo 6 at yet another price point; only the photo 1 figures were kept to avoid duplicate entries. 'Shrimp Quesadilla' appears twice (Quesadillas board $11.00, Seafood board $12.14); only the Quesadillas board price was kept. Skipped as modifiers/add-ons: Extras (hot carrots, sour cream, guacamole, cheese small add-ons). Mini Tacos and Soft Tacos are single priced items with a choice of protein, not exploded into one dish per protein.
